items: All warehouse supervisors must complete ____ training before operating the new inventory system.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'mandatory training'.
The finance department conducts an ____ review of travel expenses every January.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'annual review'.
The supplier offered a ____ price for the replacement components.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'competitive price'.
Employees are prohibited from sharing ____ information with unauthorized parties.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'confidential information'.
Customers can request ____ assistance through the support portal.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'technical assistance'.
The safety officer called for ____ action after detecting a gas leak.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'immediate action'.
The expansion plan cannot proceed without ____ approval from the board.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'formal approval'.
Drivers should allow extra time because ____ traffic is expected near the convention center.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'heavy traffic'.
The consultant charged a ____ rate for the additional analysis.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'reasonable rate'.
The planning team needs an ____ forecast before ordering raw materials.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'accurate forecast'.
The client thanked the service desk for its ____ response to the outage.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'timely response'.
Employees must provide a ____ reason when requesting an exception to the policy.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'valid reason'.
Each project proposal should state a ____ objective and measurable outcomes.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'clear objective'.
An ____ delay at customs prevented the shipment from arriving on Friday.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'unexpected delay'.
The lender offered ____ terms to customers with strong credit histories.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'favorable terms'.
The engineers proposed a ____ solution that could be implemented without replacing the entire system.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'practical solution'.
Members receive a ____ discount on conference registration fees.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'substantial discount'.
The legal team treated the regulator's inquiry as an ____ request.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'urgent request'.
The manufacturer is seeking a ____ supply of recycled aluminum for next year's production.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'stable supply'.
Tenants will receive an ____ notice before any changes to parking rules take effect.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'official notice'.
The committee expects to announce its ____ decision by the end of the week.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'final decision'.
Applicants must submit all documents before the ____ deadline listed in the notice.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'strict deadline'.
The company chose the carrier because of its ____ service during peak seasons.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'reliable service'.
The pilot program generated ____ feedback from both customers and staff.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'valuable feedback'.
The project cannot begin until ____ funding has been secured.
The natural adjective-noun collocation is 'adequate funding'.
